And when the words नाडी 'a tube' and मुष्टि 'a fist' are objects in composition with the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck', ghe affix खश् is used.

Terms: खश्

The affix फक् comes, in denoting a गोत्र descendant after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) नड etc.

Terms: फक्

The affix ड्वलच् comes after 1. नड and 2. शाद in the four senses given above, the final of the words being elided.

Terms: ड्वलच्

The augment कुक् comes aftere the words नड etc. when the affix छ follows in the above four senses.

Terms: चातुर्थिक-कुक्

The affix कप्‌ does not come after the words नाडी and तन्त्री final in a बहुव्रीहि समास when they mean organs of the body.

Terms: कप्‌
